name: Dark Fantasy
description: A dark, scuffed fantasy theme: low-saturation colours, worn materials, grim silhouettes and strong readable shapes.
palette: surface #1b1714 / #2a231d / #3b3128 / #5a4938; ink #0d0b0a; metal #6b6f73 / #43474a; rust #7a3f2a; bone #cbb89a; ember #d0783a; highlight #e6c48a.
positive: Dark fantasy pixel art: low-saturation earthy colours, worn and scuffed materials, heavy readable silhouettes, restrained highlights, a single warm ember accent. Four shading bands, dark near-black outline, no clean bright plastic surfaces.
negative: no bright saturated candy colours, no clean shiny plastic, no flat single-colour fills, no missing outline, no sci-fi neon.
